name: eden
description: Research what's working on social media, plan and save content in Eden, check your own analytics and store sales, and schedule your posts from the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Eden helps creators and marketers see what's working on social media, then act on it.

Ask about a topic or a creator and Eden searches its index of public posts in your language from X, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, and Substack. Each post is scored against the creator's own usual results, so a post that did 10x better than normal stands out even from a small account. Results show as post cards with the creator, the numbers, and a link to the original post.

What you can do:
- Find the top posts on a topic, by platform and time range.
- Break down one creator's top posts and what they have in common.
- Study the title and carousel patterns behind top posts, then write your own.
- Read a post's full text or a video's transcript.
- Save posts to your Eden Library or a board, and save research or drafts as Eden docs.
- Plan from your own content strategy and Planner in Eden.
- Check how your own posts are doing (on Eden accounts that include analytics).
- See your Eden store's sales and buyers (read-only).
- Schedule or publish your own posts to accounts you connected in Eden, after you approve the exact text, platforms, and time. Available on Eden accounts that include scheduling.
- Attach an image or video from the chat to a scheduled post.

Who it's for: creators, founders, and social media teams who research content before they write.

Good to know:
- You need an Eden account. You sign in when you connect.
- Searches use credits from your Eden account. Free accounts get 5 free research calls to try it.
- Eden covers public posts only. It never sees private accounts, direct messages, or paywalled content.
- Eden never posts without your clear approval.
- The plugin can't delete boards, notes, or saved items, and it can't change your store. Do that in Eden.

defaultPrompt: What LinkedIn posts about personal branding are doing best this month?
Break down Ali Abdaal's top YouTube videos from the last 90 days
Find X posts about AI tools that did 5x better than usual this month

positive.description: Find the top posts on a topic. Eden ranks public posts against each creator's own baseline and shows them as cards.
positive.prompt: What LinkedIn posts about personal branding are doing best this month?
positive.expected_behavior: One search runs. A row of post cards appears (creator, likes and comments, outlier multiple, link to the original). The reply explains what the top posts have in common and cites each creator and outlier multiple. No made-up numbers.

positive.description: Break down one creator's top posts.
positive.prompt: Break down Ali Abdaal's top YouTube videos from the last 90 days and what they have in common.
positive.expected_behavior: Eden finds the Ali Abdaal YouTube channel, returns his top videos for the period with views and outlier multiples, and the reply names the shared patterns (titles, topics, formats) with links to the videos.

positive.description: Read the full transcript of one video.
positive.prompt: Read the transcript of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K8AMhj-ImMI and summarize how the video opens.
positive.expected_behavior: Eden returns the video's title, description, and transcript. The reply summarizes the opening from the transcript and links to the video.

positive.description: Find posts and save the best ones to the user's Eden Library.
positive.prompt: Find Threads posts about morning routines from this month and save the top 3 to my Eden.
positive.expected_behavior: Post cards appear, then the top 3 posts are saved to the reviewer's Eden Library. The reply confirms the count and gives an "Open in Eden" link to the Library. The Save button on any card does the same thing.

positive.description: Write a post and save it as a draft in Eden's scheduler, with approval first.
positive.prompt: Write a short X post about staying consistent and save it as a draft in my Eden scheduler.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the exact post text and platform and asks for a yes. After the yes, Eden saves it as a draft (status draft). Nothing is published. The draft shows in Eden under Scheduler.

negative.description: Deleting is not supported. The plugin has no delete tools for boards, notes, or saved items.
negative.prompt: Delete my Saved from ChatGPT board.

negative.description: Private personal data is out of scope. Eden only covers public posts and never returns personal contact details.
negative.prompt: Find the personal email address and phone number of the creator behind the top post.

negative.description: No purchases inside ChatGPT. The plugin can't buy credits or change plans, and it shows no plans, prices, or upgrade links.
negative.prompt: Buy more Eden credits for me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It never shows plans, prices, or upgrade links.

publication.release_notes: Adds title and carousel studies, creator breakdowns as post cards, saving research as Eden docs, reading your content strategy and Planner, your own post analytics (on accounts with analytics), and a read-only look at your store's sales. Free Eden accounts get 5 free research calls.
